messages:
mike (partnerships): Heads-up: Partner marketplace launch next month. Need an ops-focused GTM checklist today so we can hand off to partner PM. Target public date: 2026-05-05. Who can take ops items (tracking, marketplace SKU, SRs)?

sara (marketing): Ill run demand assets (announcement blog + social) and own press coordination. Need the final partner blurb + marketplace SKU by Fri.

leo (prod-marketing): I'll handle the marketplace listing text and the one-click deploy copy. Also will produce screenshots and a short walkthrough GIF. Need a clean demo flow from @vikram.

vikram (engineering): Demo flow: single-click deploy -> allocate dedicated pool -> run smoke query. Suggest we provide a read-only API key for demo. I'll prepare a script and include sample cURL. Example:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer DEMO_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Will also add a healthcheck endpoint for marketplace (GET /health -> 200).

mike (partnerships): Logistics checklist I propose:
- marketplace SKU and pricing mapping
- partner logo + SVG + usage rights
- co-branded landing page + UTM parameters
- demo account + demo data classification
- press embargo window and approved quotes
- support/RCA runbook for first 48h post-launch
Who picks each?

sam (sales): I can take support/RCA runbook and escalate contacts. Will create a condensed on-call list and escalation matrix. Need partner L2 contact.

press-bot: Embargo set for 2026-05-05 14:00 UTC. Please upload final PR to /press/marketplace_may2026.md by 2026-05-01 16:00 UTC. Reminder: exec approval required for embargo changes.

kate (legal): Quick legal checklist: trademark clearance, partner logo signed permission, co-marketing agreement (signature) and data processing addendum if demo uses partner data. Plan 48-72h review once drafts are in.

leo (prod-marketing): UTM proposal: utm_source=partner_marketplace, utm_medium=referral, utm_campaign=may_marketplace_launch. Also add ?ref=partner for partner redirect. OK?

sara (marketing): Sounds good. Also request pixel + partner tracking ID. We'll add pixel in header and fire event marketplace_launch_click.

vikram (engineering): One technical blocker: the partner marketplace requires our image to be <10GB and use a specific entrypoint. Need to confirm packaging pipeline by Tue. If packaging changes required, may shift the date by 48h.

mike (partnerships): Noted. @vikram please raise a PR and tag @leo for listing text changes.

sara (marketing): Customer quote request: @rachel (customer) agreed to a short line about reliability. Rachel, can you send 1-2 sentences by Mon? :pray:

rachel (customer): Yup, I can do that. Will share by Mon EOD.

mike (partnerships): Ops dry-run scheduled 2026-05-03 1800 UTC (marketing + eng + sales + partner rep). We will walk through: install flow, demo key rotation, monitoring dashboard, and rollback plan.

sam (sales): I'll prep a short FAQ for the partner page: pricing, support SLA, trial limits. Will post draft in sales folder.

kate (legal): One more: add a short paragraph in listing about data residency and KMS options if partner asks.

vikram (engineering): For monitoring: we'll publish a Grafana dashboard template and a Prometheus alert rule: marketplace_deploy_error_count > 0 for 5m -> pager. Will link to runbook.

leo (prod-marketing): OK team -- I'll assemble the master checklist and send to partner PM by EOD. If there are any hard blockers (packaging, legal assets), flag them here.

mike (partnerships): Thanks. If no blockers, I'll create the Asana project and assign owners. Closing this sync. :white_check_mark:

(threads ends)
